100 MB streamed upload safety cap; old 8 MB limit removed
up to 20000 Karnataka Recovery rows per run, supporting a 15000-row enhanced batch
up to 20000 compact Avika rows per run
durable automatic checkpoint resume after Railway restarts or worker interruption
